data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mawiyyah means 'gift from God'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'mawī', which translates to 'gift'. In Islamic tradition, the name holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the blessings bestowed upon us by Allah. The name Mawiyyah carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
